# AiringRow

One upcoming episode of a tracked show: a date tile, the show and episode, and when it airs; used in Home's Airing Soon list.

`TVTracker.AiringRow` · Media

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.AiringRow day="…" date={…} title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.AiringRow" day="…" date="{{…}}" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (AiringRowProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `day` * | `string` | Short weekday, e.g. "Thu". |
| `date` * | `string \| number` | Day of the month, e.g. "19". |
| `title` * | `string` | Show title. |
| `episode` | `string` | e.g. "S2 · E3 · Chapter Three" |
| `when` | `string` | Relative time, e.g. "Tonight · 21:00", "In 2 days". |
| `soon` | `boolean` | Highlights `when` in accent-text (airs today). |
| `href` | `string` | Makes the row a link to the show. |
